title: Current Issues
description:
The cards rendered into the #issues section (Explore More -> Current Issues). Nine at the time of the audit. Text fields accept a safe HTML subset (, , ,
) and {{fact:}} tokens; anything else is escaped and unknown tags fail the build.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file, so editors validate on save.

section_intro.description: Lead paragraph above the grid. Should carry a {{fact:issues-last-updated}} token rather than a literal month -- the audit found this saying 'September 2026' while the footer said 'June 2026'.

issues.description: DISPLAY ORDER IS ARRAY ORDER. There is deliberately no 'order' field: a second source of ordering is a second thing to keep in sync.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug. Becomes the card's DOM id and anchor target, and is the key the RAG pipeline tags Examiner articles against. Never renumber or reword -- inbound links and article tags break.

title.description: Card headline (h3). Plain text, no markup.

status.description: Drives the coloured dot: renders as CSS class .dot-<value>. Only these three exist in the stylesheet. Adding a fourth (e.g. 'urgent') requires adding matching CSS first, or the dot renders unstyled.

status_label.description: The sentence beside the dot, e.g. 'Active -- board weighing appointment vs. referendum; October meeting scheduled'. Free text: it is a status summary, not a repeat of the enum.

tag.description: The words printed on the chip: 'Budget / Taxes', 'Personnel', 'Elections'. Deliberately NOT the same as tag_style -- the audit found tag-budget carrying three different labels and tag-energy carrying two.

tag_style.description: Chip colour only: renders as CSS class .tag-<value>. Many labels share one style; that is intended. Must match an existing .tag-<value> rule.

description.description: Card body copy. Safe HTML subset plus {{fact:<id>}} tokens -- write {{fact:village-budget-fy2627}}, never a literal dollar figure.

governing_body.description: Foreign keys to bodies.json ids. An ARRAY because issues span bodies: the EMS station is Town + Village, the Con Ed rate case is Village + County. Build fails on an id with no matching body.

source_url.description: Primary source link. May be an on-page anchor such as '#elections'.

source_label.description: Link text WITHOUT a date, e.g. 'Pelham Examiner'. The date comes from source_date so every card renders it the same way -- today they are inconsistently formatted inline.

source_date.description: Publication date of the source (YYYY-MM-DD). Null for undated links like a search page.

last_updated.description: When a human last reviewed this card against its source (YYYY-MM-DD). Surfaced by the build as a staleness warning.

keywords.description: Retrieval hints for the Ask Pelham RAG step -- names, places and phrases a resident might type that do not appear verbatim in the title. Not rendered.

show_on_home.description: False hides the card from the grid while keeping it in the file (resolved issues worth retaining for the AI and for history). Hidden issues still feed the system prompt.
